title: reversible-pebbling: machine-checked results on reversible pebble games
description: Lean 4 (and Rocq) formalisations of reversible pebble games with their full development history: the exact growth rate of space-optimal reversible pebbling of chains (the Knill constant), erasure-budgeted clean pebbling of chains, fixed-event line pebblings, spooky pebbling, reversible pebbling of complete binary trees, and further variants. Status labels (general theorem, bounded machine check, paper proof, draft) are given in each part.
